LESSON: SORTING &

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: CLASSIFICATION
Topic 1.1: Sorting &

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Sorting &. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify similarities and 8 lessons objects for distinguishing one object from the other
2. sort and group objects in their environment
3. group objects in the environment according to more than one attribute

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify similarities and 8 lessons objects for distinguishing one object from the other
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify similarities and 8 lessons objects for distinguishing one object from the other. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. sort and group objects in their environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sort and group objects in their environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. group objects in the environment according to more than one attribute
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to group objects in the environment according to more than one attribute. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the materials in the environment for their• Learners in groups or pairs, uniqueness and diversity according to more than one attribute up to four groups. other objects in the environment grouping objects. respective corners. according to more than one attribute using ICT devices.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Sorting &.
2. Explain Sorting & to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sorting &.
4. Show that you can: identify similarities and 8 lessons objects for distinguishing one object from the other
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Sorting &. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Sorting & important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify similarities and 8 lessons objects for distinguishing one object from the other
2. sort and group objects in their environment
3. group objects in the environment according to more than one attribute
4. appreciate the materials in the environment for their• Learners in groups or pairs, uniqueness and diversity according to more than one attribute up to four groups. other objects in the environment grouping objects. respective corners. according to more than one attribute using ICT devices.
